name: flyrank-context
title_zh: 入职前先补 FlyRank 这家公司到底在搜什么的背
tagline_zh: 任务里冒出 FlyRank、flags、beat the rule 这些词时，先别急着写代码——它把公司做什么。
tagline_en: When a task drops FlyRank, flags, or 'beat the rule' and you're guessing at acronyms, this lays out the product.
desc_en: FlyRank-specific background — what the company does, the search problem, and the hand-written flags story that the ML internship work builds on. Load for context when an assignment references FlyRank's product, flags, or the "beat the rule" framing. (Project-specific: delete this folder when reusing the skill library elsewhere.)
why_zh: 它不教模型，只交代任务背后的业务语境：那批手写 flags 是怎么来的、哪里开始不够用。缺了它。
why_en: It teaches no models, only the business context: where the hand-written flags came from and where they stop scaling. Without it.
limit_zh: 只对 FlyRank 自己的实习任务有用，换到别的项目请直接删掉这个文件夹；它不含任何数据集、代码或评测脚本。
limit_en: Only useful for FlyRank's own internship tasks; delete this folder when reusing the library elsewhere. No datasets, code, or eval scripts — reading.
title_en: Background pack on what FlyRank actually searches for
